🟡 **Medium** `src/sourceControl.ts:136`

`SCP_SSH_REMOTE_PATTERN` allows a `/` after the host, so a local path like `deploy@github.com/project/repo` matches the regex and `isSshRemoteUrl()` returns `true`. Git only treats `user@host:path` as an SCP-like SSH remote when the first separator after the host is `:`, not `/`; without the colon it is a local path. As a result, `parseRemoteHost()` also extracts a host from local paths, causing `detectSourceControlProviderFromRemoteUrl()` to misclassify the remote as GitHub instead of returning `null`. Consider requiring `:` instead of `[:/]` in the pattern.

✅ Resolved in 536dc179add4c08b27b331475cf051bf225243f1
